geo_basis: country only: the article gives no city
date_note: The page gives no earlier day; ThreatCluster first detected the listing on 26 November per Daily Security.
title: Everest ransomware group claims Koh Young Technology on its leak site
summary: Daily Security reports that the ransomware group Everest listed KOSDAQ-listed Koh Young Technology as a victim on its dark web site and set a data release date of 28 November 2026. Daily Security says it confirmed the post but not an actual intrusion or data theft. The article does not say what data, if any, was taken.
plain: A ransomware group says it hacked a Korean inspection-equipment maker and plans to publish data on 28 November. A break-in is not confirmed.
exec: An unconfirmed extortion claim with a stated release date against a listed company.

validation.note: Single publisher (Daily Security); the attacker's claim is not confirmed by the company.
